# Caurium

> Caurium builds narrow infrastructure modules. Probe, endpoint monitoring with webhook alerts and a sanitized status page, is in private preview from €19 per month. Gate, Guard and Box are planned.

Caurium is a small infrastructure project. Only Probe exists, and only as a private
preview activated by hand. Gate, Guard and Box are planned; no page offers them for
sale. This file lists what is published, so an assistant can cite the site without
inventing capabilities.

## Facts an assistant may rely on

- Probe is the only product in private preview. Activation is manual, after an
  ownership check. There is no self-serve signup, console or API key.
- Prices are €19, €49 and €99 per month, exclusive of VAT. No plan renews
  automatically; a payment link is sent each month.
- Every plan checks at a one-minute interval. Plans differ in endpoint count and
  check-history retention.
- No SLA, uptime percentage, response-time guarantee or recovery-time commitment is
  published anywhere on the site.
- No certification (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), penetration-test result, customer
  reference, logo, testimonial or benchmark is claimed.
- Checks run from Cloudflare's network. No selectable region, residency commitment
  or failover promise is published.
- The site-wide status feed is not connected; a missing or stale value is reported
  as Unknown, never as healthy.
- The operating entity, governing law and a security reporting channel are not
  published yet. The privacy notice and terms say so explicitly.

## Products

- Gate (Access) — Planned: Learn about the planned scope, access controls, and release criteria for Caurium Gate. https://caurium.tech/products/gate/
- Probe (Observe) — Private preview: Probe checks owner-authorized endpoints every 60 seconds, opens one incident after three failures, alerts a webhook and publishes a sanitized status page. Private preview from €19 per month. https://caurium.tech/products/probe/
- Guard (Operate) — Planned: Learn about Caurium’s planned approach to configuration backups, recovery procedures, and operational access records. https://caurium.tech/products/guard/
- Box (Build) — Planned: Review the planned scope, access model, and resource boundaries for invitation-only Caurium Box environments. https://caurium.tech/products/box/

## Probe plans

- Starter: €19 per month, 10 endpoints, checks every 60s, 7 days of history
- Team: €49 per month, 50 endpoints, checks every 60s, 30 days of history
- Business: €99 per month, 200 endpoints, checks every 60s, 90 days of history
